capability: Every recalled answer carries its source
title: Every answer keeps its receipt.

hook.picture: Close on the whale reading a pod's answer card aloud. The card has no tick in its corner. A customer pod takes the answer and turns a copper ✕.
hook.words: The bot said the policy changed.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The bot quoted a rule, and nobody could say where from.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: support lead after a wrong refund

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three heaps of cards (chat, code, docs) feed one pod. First answer leaves with no tick and a pod turns ✕ (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Answers arrive with no name on them.

stakes.body: A wrong answer gets acted on, and nobody can trace it, fix it at the source, or warn anyone else.

solution_hint: Tag each note with where it came from.

metaphor.body: Every card the pod brings back has a small tick in its corner, and a thin line runs from that tick back to the exact message it came from. Copper alarm.

steps.picture: Cards rise from the three heaps. The whale stamps a tick on each one: chat, code, docs. Each tick shows a place, a time and a name.
steps.words: Tag each note: where, when, who.
steps.sound: Signature tick, in tune, one per stamp

steps.picture: A pod asks one question. Cards from all three heaps rise together and line up in front of it, every tick showing.
steps.words: One search across all three places.

steps.picture: Push-in: the whale taps the top card's tick. A thin line runs back across the sea to one exact chat message, with its time and author lit.
The thin line glows and stays. The tick is now visibly the start of a trail.

real_case.claim: OmniMemory (in development) states that each search result includes source attribution with platform, timestamp and author metadata, across Slack, GitHub and Google Drive.

honest_limit.picture: Push into one tagged card: its tick is perfect, but its body carries a copper smudge. The pod quotes it and a reader pod turns ✕. The tick never changed.
honest_limit.words: A tagged note can still be wrong.

not_this.body: A source tag is not a fact check.

ending_pattern.body: The same answer card as act 1, now with a tick and a glowing trail to its source. The whale follows it home before the customer acts.
ending_pattern.callback: Act 1's blank card corner now holds a tick with a trail, so the copper ✕ never lands.

end_belief.body: Ask every answer where it came from.
